data.gender_notes: Solange is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the French word ‘solange’, meaning sun. It was also the name of a 17th-century French poet and a saint. The name Solange carries the meaning “Sun, Sun Goddess” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Solange usually hope their child will grow to embody sun, sun goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Solange total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_greek.name: Σολάνζ
in_greek.long_meaning: το όνομα Σολάνζ προέρχεται από την λατινική λέξη sol, που σημαίνει ηλίου, και την ελληνική λέξη ἀγγέλος, που σημαίνει άγγελος, και σημαίνει ηλίου φως και άγιος, και είναι σύμβολο του φωτός και της ζωής στην χριστιανική παράδοση

in_latin.name: Solange

in_english.name: Solange

data.cultural_impact: The name Solange holds a beautiful cultural significance, derived from the French word meaning ‘sun.’ This connection to the sun can evoke feelings of warmth, brightness, and energy. In today's world, the name Solange hearkens back to its French origins and is often associated with the romantic and artistic influences of the French language and culture.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, Saint Solange is referenced as a martyr from the 7th century, known for her unwavering faith and strength in the face of persecution. The spiritual significance of the name Solange lies in its meaning as a source of light and warmth, echoing the divine light and warmth of God. It also represents resilience, as evoked by the life and martyrdom of Saint Solange. Therefore, the name Solange can serve as a reminder of the light, warmth, and strength found in both our faith and our sun.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Solange in French means "sunlight." In Christian context, it symbolizes the radiant grace and warmth of God's love, shining upon us with unwavering constancy, guiding us through life's journey.

historical_references.reference: According to legend, Solange was a noblewoman in 13th century France who was renowned for her exceptional beauty. She was the sister of Marie de Champagne, the famous patroness of the troubadours. Solange was admired not only for her physical appearance but also for her virtues of kindness, generosity, and grace.

Another reference to Solange is in the 17th century novel 'Clarissa' by Samuel Richardson. In this novel, Clarissa Harlowe is compared to the medieval saint Solange for her purity and self-sacrifice. The character of Solange is mentioned in the context of Clarissa's contemplation of her own virtues.

modern_usage.modern_context: Solange Knowles is a contemporary R&B musician, fashion influencer, and social activist. She has a large following on Instagram, where she shares her personal style and promotes her music. On TikTok, fans create videos using her music and dance along to her beats. Solange's music can also be streamed on Apple Music and other digital platforms.
